page.overview:
Who is Cucco Lady?

The is a character in . This was changed to Cucco Lady in .}}

The Cucco Lady can be found in Kakariko Village, where she raises and tends to her Cuccos. The Cucco Lady is allergic to Cuccos, so she has a hard time taking care of them and keeping them inside the pen. When Link first meets her, the Cuccos will be running around all over the village. As the Cucco Lady cannot do it herself, she asks the young Hero of Time to round them up and bring them back to their pen. For Link's help, she will reward him with a Bottle. Upon bringing back the for a second time, the will give him a .

When Link returns to Kakariko Village as an adult, he can speak to the Cucco Lady to begin the Trading Quest. She will tell him that she bred a special new type of miniature Cucco that does not give her an allergic reaction. She then gives him the Pocket Egg which he must carry until it hatches. After the egg hatches, Link must use it to wake up Talon, and then return the new Cucco to the Cucco Lady. She will compliment Link's ability to care for Cuccos and entrust him with her brother's blue Cucco, Cojiro.

In the ending of the game, the Cucco Lady can be seen juggling several Cuccos in front of Medigoron at Lon Lon Ranch.
